transcript: And she's on schedule here! She needs to run around 30 for the last 200! She's ahead of the line! She's Olympic champion, a world champion! She's done both of those things twice before! But she's never broken the world record! It's an incredible world record! She's looking a little bit tired now, but she's left the life behind!
